description: Seed registry for the deep-hedging pass-5 experiments. Every reported number is traceable to one of these seed sets. NOTE: MPS (Apple Silicon) is not bit-deterministic even at a fixed seed; CUDA is far tighter. Report the cross-seed spread and the block-bootstrap CIs, not point estimates.
set_seed_implementation: random.seed(s); np.random.seed(s); torch.manual_seed(s) [+ torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(s) on CUDA]; called before each model's training so models are seed-matched within a run
